lines.line: And the robot runs rampant! Who can put a stop to this carnage?
Oooh! Fleck making it look easy!
Fabulous! Fierce! Fleck finishing another foe!
It's time! Now! Scrap or be scrapped!
No time for pulled punches. Ready? Brawl!
Get ready to make them fall 'cause its time for a MEGA BRAWL!!
Time to turn up the heat!
And Fleck sails through another round!
And Fleck is eliminated. You hate to see it folks.
And that's game over for Fleck!
A monster mech here to deck Fleck? Time for the bots to BRAWL!
Mean Queen Blasting Machine! Here comes Maxine!
Who's ready for a Robot Rumble?
Fleck faces off with a fierce foe.
A clash with this enemy is sure to be quite the spectacle.
Fleck makes a mockery of this mechanical menace.
From bumper cars to seeing stars!
The Cool Car's wheels are burning hot!
Aaand Fleck hits the breaks with that one!
Fleck sends another one to the repair shop!
And the men of monochrome get sent home!
Fleck bats away the bullet barrage!
Fleck has the soldiers seeing stars!
Looks like they're blasting off again!
Fleck sends the stegosaurus staggering home!
And they takedown the timeless titan!
They're stegoing going gone after that one!
The furious fossil fuels Fleck's fury!
Looks like the spinners won't be winners this round folks!
Fleck looking like a top contender!
The shredder is left spinning out of control!
Time for the titans to clash!
And the moment you've been waiting for, its time for the Grand Finale!
All or nothing, this is it folks!
All eyes are on these two, but only one can take home the title!
It all comes down to this. Who's ready for a Robot Rumble!
Fleck comes out on top! Everyone make some noise for your Champion!
The smoke clears, who's left standing? It's Fleck!
We have a winner! Fleck takes home the trophy!
A climactic finish! Fleck is victorious!
What a finale! Fleck finishes in first!
I'm suprised you made it this far, Fluke. I guess it's kinda impressive... but this is a whole nother level. I don't have time for whatever toddler's toy you brought.
As if that's even remotely possible! You're a C-tier pilot with a D-tier Mech. Now quit babbling and let's get this over with.
Impressive. Your cheap little rust bucket held itself together. Let's see if you survive with your bot being held together by hopes and dreams.
N'aww. Don't be upset just because I'm better than you, Flunk.
Sounds like someone's jealous that they have to settle for their little junk bot.

Eh well just depends on what you mean by "fair." Like I don't think its "fair" to have me and you even competing on the same level. Honestly I'm not sure there's anything "fair", "equal", or even "comparable" between us at all.
That’s not fair! You cheated! Mr. Fairwell, I demand you ban them this instant!
How! There's no way! My robot could never lose to someone like you! Someone so... so... RAH!
This... this has to be some sort of mistake. It's just not possible. I-I don't. I can't lose.
Nice try, Fluke. But luck alone isn't enough to beat someone with real skill.
Yep just what I thought. You'll never be a real BRAWLER. Oh oh! Maybe see if the sports club is interested in a loser like you.
You climbed so high just to fall so far. Better luck next time, Flop.
Right back to where you belong, Flunk. Beneath me.
Let me show you real firepower!
Here's where it all comes crashing down!
Where's the fun in playing fair?
I won't let you make a fool of me! OMEGA!
Here. I'll show you who I really am! OMEGA!
Rah! I wasn't even trying! I'll show you! OMEGA!
Fool! This isn't even my final form. OMEGA!
I'll make sure there's nothing left!
Try and run! Nowhere is safe!
No one is out of my reach!
Turn up the heat! Hotter! Hotter than the Sun!
That's it! Scorch it all! Leave nothing!!
Oooh. That look like it wheel-y hurt.  Haha!
*sigh* And this is why mama says to always wear a seatbelt.
Head in the game... Arms and legs too.
Lock in, buddy. Let's kick some butt.
Get ready, Bentley. I'm on my way.
There's a lesson here somewhere... Right Mr. F?
What's wrong? Cat got your tongue?
You're in the deep end now!
That's what you get for treading in dangeous waters.
Come get these hands, steaming hot!
Aaaand another one. Though who's keeping track?
See you on the other side!
Your spirit and fate are sealed.
I don't have time for sportsball or whatever, Rufus.
I see Bentley didn't wanna get his hands dirty. Alright, let's go.
Oh boy. Bentley didn't have anything better for you to do?
Can we skip this part? We both know you're gonna be mad when I trash your bot.
You want something to fix? One busted bot coming right up.
Oh what, is the Bentley Blaster 9000 finally warmed up?
Better be careful, that one looks dangerous.
That one might be a challenge.
This one might be a problem.
A strong one, but not strong enough.
Tell Bentley I'm heading his way next.
I'm getting real tire-d of you...
Guess I have to shift gears...
You need to up your handling...
Y'know, I don't think that's what they mean by "break to stop."
Who needs an army when you got skills like these?
Sorry guys. You're gonna need some heavier artillery.
Don't be a saur loser. haha.
Bam! Sent 'em back to the stone age.
Hope you're not too dizzy, Stacy.
Not sure if that was your top performance.
Yeah? You better not lose to this "toddler's toy." Sure would be embarrasing.
Blah blah blah. We get it. Your dad's got money. Do you talk about anything else?
Right. A huge jerk too. Almost forgot. Well let's see if daddy bought you some piloting lessons.
So, got something new this time Bentley, or just the same bot as usual?
Whatever, I'm sure I'll find a way to beat you either way.
We gonna have a fair fight this time, Bentley?
Good work little buddy. Fist bump. Pow!
I can't wait to tell mom and dad about this one.
Come on! Did you see that? I was like ‘Pow!’ And he was like ‘BOOM!’ Hah! Crazy, right?
Alright! That's what im talking about!
Finally! All that hardwork paid off.
Don't take this personally, Fleck. It's just business.
Bentley sends his regards, Blah blah blah, alright lets go.
I've done enough repairs for today. Let's break something.
Alright, time for the big guns.
Blasters of disaster, armed and dangerous.
Come on, put up a fight. My data depends on it.
I'm failing to see why Bentley's worried about you.
My aim’s gotta be off or something.
Ah, great. Better get to repairs before Bentley flips out.
You got lucky I made a miscalculation...
Let's get up close and personal.
I hope your feet are faster than these hands.
Get ready. Imma knock you off your feet.
Where do you think you're going.
You know I can't let you win Fleck.
Better keep those hands up, Fleck.
See you again soon. This isn't over.
One dino dinner coming right up!
Oof! Now imagine if that was a meteor.
Are you trying to go extinct?
Aww. Now my stego’s feeling saur…
It's fine, they're just taking an exca-vacation.
Three spinners are better than one!
Ugh. I think my head is spinning.
Come on Stacy, spin that frown upside down.

Alright Fleck, since you’re new to this, I figured it would be best if we start you off with some one-on-one training. Don’t worry, I’ve got you set up with the best coach in the world. Take it away Sophie!
There we go! Alright where were we? Oh right! *ahem*
Alright! Let Sophie show you how business gets done. Imma walk you through the basics of Brawling, but first gotta builds you a bot.
Without further ado, welcome to Build-a-Bot! Here you can customize your bot however ya like! Here, I’ll show you around.
First, lemme introduce you to the tub of holding!
This mystical box of magic will store any part you collect neatly in a messy pile!
All you gotta do is pick a part. Here grab whichever one you like and we’ll try it out.
Move your mitts over the part you wanna select.
When you pick up a part the handy dandy “part-info-o-matica” will show you what it does, that way you know what sort of mayhem these babies are capable of.
Whenever you're done lookin’ at  all that, simply drag the part into its corresponding slot.
A little tip for ya: there’s two slots for your arms, one for the legs and one for the chassis. Doesn't matter what side you put the arms on so long as you end up with one on each side.
If you mess up, you can always hover on over and remove a part that doesn't quite match your “vibes” or whatever.
You can also bring up the “part-info-o-matica” again in case you forgot what a part does… or if you didn’t read it the first time.
Alright, enough goofing around. Let’s build that bot!
Good. Now that that’s all settled, why don’t we test this beauty out in the arena? Don’t worry I’ll take it easy on you. Hehehe.
Let’s start by getting those legs moving. Always a good idea to be warmed up before blowing things up.
Right, now let’s really get going. Try hitting the boosters!
Light on your feet, I like it! That oughta give you a little oomph in a pinch.
Remember your dash can be used to get you outta sticky situations or help you close the gaps on a slippery foe.
Personally, I’d try to save it for when it's necessary, but who am I to stop you if you gotta go fast?
Onto the fun stuff, hitting things!
If you wanna hit things good, best to make sure you're facing the right way. Sorry, no targeting systems, so you gotta do it yourself.
Once you got yourself lined up, give me your best shot. Don’t worry I can take it. I gotta magical impenetrable bubble of awesome hamster powers.
Come on! Is that the best you got? You can pack more of a punch than that. Show me something special!
Yes! That’s it! Now, one last thing to try.
As you beat the brakes off your foes, you’ll earn a little bit of charge.
Once your meter is filled up you can unleash an ultimate attack! Go on. Gimme everything you got!
There you go! Now you’re getting the hang of it. Keep this up and you’ll be a rootin’ shootin’ professional MEGA BRAWLER in no time!
Completing fights earns you some glory in the form of all powerful magical artifacts.
Careful these artifacts are sticky. Some might even call them stickers- but like magical space stickers obviously.
Anyways lemme show you how to use em.
Whenever you earn a new sticker you can place it on your arm *cough cough* I mean inside the engine of your mech, giving it a little boost.
Go ahead and pick one up, spin it around, and place it on your arm. You can place 'em wherever you want. It’s your arm: you do you.
Looks like you also unlocked a new robot part! Go ahead and open it.
Oooooh, you got three nice shiny options here. Now pick one to keep for now. Why only one? Weeeeeell… we gotta keep things fair somehow.
Great work! Now let’s head on back to Build-a-Bot. I got some more things to show you.
Once you place your sticker it’ll show up here on this very inventively named sticker-tracker-inator.
Here you can see what stickers you’ve collected and what they do.
Keep your eye out for LEGENDARY stickers sets that give you extra cool bonuses, if you get them all.
Also, now that you’ve got yourself some more parts you can try mixing it up a bit. Go ahead and grab one of the new ones.
Now that you got it, go ahead and drag it over one of your old parts. Don’t worry if you end up liking the old one better you can always switch it back.
Your old parts will be returned to the bin of holding.
Now of course I never pick favorites, but if you don’t want to lose your favorite parts in the bin of holding, you can drop your favorite parts on the Safe Mat.
The Safe Mat uses magical powers to remember your favorite parts in between your fights so you don’t gotta go digging for ‘em again.
Alright that’s all the wisdom I got for ya. You’re on your own from here kid.
Give it your best shot. I’ll be here cheering you on from the sidelines. And most importantly remember to have fun out there. Now, go kick some butt!
Nice work, Fleck. You’re gonna do great!
Thank you Sophie. Don’t forget to say thank you too, Fleck.
